recipe.visualDefinition: A sun-drenched coastal scene featuring three figures in 1960s-era fashion posed among weathered driftwood logs, characterized by a bright, slightly desaturated color palette and ornate, psychedelic-influenced typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures integrated into the natural geometry of driftwood
Typography anchored to the sky area for legibility
Vertical figures contrasting with horizontal water line
Graphic badges overlapping the photographic background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures distributed across the mid-ground; one central and larger, two flanking and slightly smaller.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in dark clothing and tan trousers sitting on the largest driftwood log.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the central figure, moves up to the decorative title in the top right, then sweeps left across the background figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and water in the upper left and right provide breathing room for text and logos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and sandy tans from the coastal environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark browns and blacks in the clothing to ground the figures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant purple and magenta used for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Mid-range saturation with high brightness, mimicking aged film photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sun-bleached earth tones and sky blues

letterConstructionRules: Circular motifs integrated into letterforms (e.g., dots inside 'O' or 'E')
Variable stroke width with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand styled as a decorative flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair decorative display lettering with a clean, small sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Jagged starburst/seal badge with sans-serif text
Small geometric logo in the corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing curves of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of three people in 1960s fashion (bell-bottoms, turtlenecks) posing on large driftwood logs on a sunny beach with calm blue water and a clear sky. Use a vintage film aesthetic with soft grain and sun-bleached colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering in the top right corner using a purple-to-magenta palette. The lettering should be Art Nouveau-inspired with spiral flourishes. Add a white jagged starburst seal to the right of the figures with small red sans-serif text inside.

verificationChecks: Does the typography feature circular motifs?
Are the clothes historically accurate to the late 60s?
Is the lighting consistent with a bright coastal day?

mustRedesign: Specific song titles or artist names

mustAchieve: Cohesive integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in posed figures
Ensure text does not obscure faces
Verify the 'sun-bleached' color grade is consistent across the frame
Confirm the starburst badge looks like a printed sticker
recipe.reuseFormula: Coastal landscape + 1960s fashion + Art Nouveau display type = Retro Pop Aesthetic
